statement: (let fold3 := fun (a b c : Nat) => let mn := Nat.min a (Nat.min b c); let mx := Nat.max a (Nat.max b c); 2 * (2 * mn + (a + b + c - mn - mx)) + mx; (fold3 1 2 3 = fold3 1 3 2) ∧ (fold3 1 2 3 = fold3 2 1 3) ∧ (fold3 1 2 3 = fold3 2 3 1) ∧ (fold3 1 2 3 = fold3 3 1 2) ∧ (fold3 1 2 3 = fold3 3 2 1))
